maul believes `echo-kept` has a defect: the evaluator reported the outcome fails, and maul's own runs of the check it saved to show it, each alone under a fresh run token, failed the same assertion. maul does not fix a defect found this way on its own: a person should confirm it. An approver's `/maul verify fix` starts a fix round, handed the reproduction below. Known limits: an exec or run check's failed assertion is whatever its program reports, so a program that reports every failure that way can look like this.
